priorityList.notes: Shadow Word: Pain is kept up unless the fight is about to end, when refreshing it would waste most of the DoT.

Shadow Word: Death (sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go): Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent gives it bonus crit chance below 20% target health, read through the engine's execute-phase approximation (isExecutePhase E20, the same primitive this line already used).
Era fallback for the execute window when Shadow Word: Death is on its own 15 s cooldown: Mind Blast on cooldown, else Mind Flay.
Inner Focus into Devouring Plague: a free, empowered cast of the priest's biggest single-target nuke, at rank 6 (19280), spellconst's top rank and the highest the engine registers at level 60.
Mind Flay fills every remaining global, including the rest of the execute fallback above.

Shoot (5019, core.RegisterShootSpell) is the wand-weaving fallback added by the rotation-accuracy program's caster-wand finding (2026-09-28): sim/priest never enabled a ranged auto attack or registered a Shoot action, so a leveling shadow priest's equipped wand dealt zero damage even though the ladder harness always equips one. Gated below 20 percent mana so it only fills globals Mind Flay could no longer afford; the engine multiplies its damage by the Wand Specialization talent's 13/25 percent bonus when taken.
